In this video: My last non-OC upload in honor of 9/11 today is a documentary on the insane, warmongering cabinet of George W. Bush, whose "neoconservative" or "neocon" administration, in the name of 9/11 and the so-called "war on terror," dramatically changed the US and world for the worse, unleashing war after war, militarized the police, and greatly increased the cultural, economic, and other rifts within Western society.

"They brought us war against Iraq - what do the hawks in Washington have in store for us now? Panorama investigates the "neo-conservatives", the small and unelected group of right-wingers, who critics claim have hijacked the White House. Throughout the war with Iraq, Steve Bradshaw was with the neocons in Washington - discovering whether they're really trying to run the world the American way." - BBC

In my opinion, the official story of the 9/11 terror attacks was completely impossible and fake, but also more than that, the only possible way that what happened on 9/11 could have happened was from the inside of the US government and military, most likely by a far-right faction with close ties to the Bush administration.
